title: Add a task
statement: tick add <title> [--due YYYY-MM-DD] creates a task with an optional due date.
rationale: Core capture path — the whole tool exists to catch tasks at mention time.

title: List open tasks, overdue flagged
statement: tick list shows open tasks; a task past its due date is flagged OVERDUE; a task due today is NOT overdue.
rationale: Overdue visibility is the team's stated pain; the due-today boundary has bitten them before.

title: Mark a task done
statement: tick done <id> completes the task and stamps the completion time.
rationale: Closing the loop; feeds the history view.

title: Show task history
statement: tick history <id> shows when the task was added and when it was done.

title: Tasks persist between runs
statement: Task state survives process exit via an on-disk store.
rationale: Without persistence the tool is a toy.

title: Recurring tasks
statement: Recurring tasks (e.g. weekly stand-up) re-appear on their cadence. Missed-occurrence behavior is UNDECIDED [NEEDS-CLARIFICATION: OQ-001].
rationale: Explicit team ask, deliberately under-specified in the brief.

title: CSV export
statement: tick export --csv writes open+done tasks as CSV to stdout.
rationale: Team-lead P.S. in the brief — monthly report.

title: Stdlib only
statement: No third-party packages; Python 3.10+ stdlib only.
